issues.title: Bengaluru: conversion down across the city
issues.cause: Market problem, not one store: city conversion 12.9% vs 14.4% in the same 13 weeks last year (-10%, rest of the network -3%); 4 of 4 stores are down.

issues.rupees_formula: (city conversion last year − now) × walk-ins (13 wks) × avg bill value, per 4 weeks
